name: Rock Hill
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Rock Hill for 2026, and here is what he found: 18 family events once the Fort Mill, Lake Wylie and Carowinds cards move off the page, 16 already live plus 2 new. The magic runs from November 30 (Story Time with Santa at Clover Library) through at least December 13 (A Beautiful Christmas at Fewell Park), with ChristmasVille from December 3, the Rock Hill Christmas Parade (December 4) and the Brattonsville candlelight tours (December 12 and 13) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Rock Hill

  • 2 new Christmas events for kids in Rock Hill: the ChristmasVille Opening Ceremony and A Beautiful Christmas
  • Meet Santa: Santa's Arrival at Fountain Park on December 3 and the Santa meet and greet at Fewell Park on December 13
  • Parades and tree lightings: Rock Hill Christmas Parade on December 4 and ChristmasVille
  • Season: December 3, 2026 to December 13, 2026 for the new events

Planning a bigger day out? Rock Hill families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Charlotte, which covers Carowinds Winterfest, THE POLAR EXPRESS at the N.C. Transportation Museum, Christmas Town U.S.A. in McAdenville and Holidays at the Garden at Daniel Stowe.
